purpose: the frozen Full PAL (Tavus persona) of the StreamEval v1 Tavus CVI Full systems. Create it once on your account from `request` (POST https://tavusapi.com/v2/personas) and set TAVUS_PAL_ID to the returned persona_id; before every session the live persona's pinned_fields are compared with `persona`. Per-case conversational_context and dynamic_greeting false are set per conversation.

request.system_prompt: You are the character described in the conversational context of this call. Stay in that role, answer the user from the facts the context provides, and speak English.

persona.system_prompt: You are the character described in the conversational context of this call. Stay in that role, answer the user from the facts the context provides, and speak English.

replica_selection.rule: stock system replicas, completed, available for the plan (144) -> phoenix-4.5 and provider-recommended (30) -> explicit 'office' or 'home' tag (4: Dr. Carol, Deborah, Jamie, Lee) -> neutral role, drop 'medical' -> casual presentation like the LiveAvatar stock avatar (chest-up, frontal, office) (Jamie, Lee: same office shoot) -> lowest replica_id: Jamie

omitted: the account-specific persona_id and timestamps, and credential-named fields of the persona layers (empty strings in the frozen persona)
